items.title: Train Your Own O1 Preview Model Within $450
items.raw_content: Models such as o1 and Gemini 2.0 flash thinking that excel in reasoning have shown to solve complex tasks by producing a long internal chain of thought, among other advancements. However, the technical details and model weights are un-accessible, presenting a barrier to the participation of the academic and open-source communities. In response, a few notable efforts have emerged to train open-weight reasoning models in the math domain, such as Still-2 and Journey . Concurrently, we, the NovaSky team at UC Berkeley, have been exploring various techniques to evolve the reasoning capabilities of base and instruct-tuned models. In this work, we achieve competitive reasoning performance not just in math, but also in coding in the same model.
items.title_zh: 450 美元以内，训练你自己的 O1 级推理模型
items.summary: UC Berkeley's NovaSky team describes its efforts to evolve the reasoning capabilities of base and instruct-tuned models, reporting competitive performance in both math and coding. The team notes that systems such as o1 and Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking keep their technical details and model weights inaccessible.

items.title: The secret ingredients of word2vec (2016)
items.title_zh: word2vec 的成功秘诀（2016）
items.summary: The article argues that word2vec's success comes mostly from particular architecture choices, and that transferring those choices to traditional distributional methods makes them competitive with popular word embedding techniques.

items.title: Money lessons without money: The financial literacy fallacy
items.title_zh: 没有钱的钱财课：金融素养的谬误
items.summary: The article argues that financial literacy taught without real-world experience of money is ineffective, comparing it to teaching swimming with PowerPoint slides.

items.title_zh: Greg K-H：“用 Rust 写新代码对我们所有人都有益”

items.summary: Obsidian says its commercial license is now optional, so anyone can use the app for work at no cost. The company also launched an Enterprise page listing organizations that support Obsidian.

items.title: Docker limits unauthenticated pulls to 10/HR/IP from Docker Hub, from March 1
items.title_zh: Docker 自 3 月 1 日起将未认证拉取限制为每 IP 每小时 10 次
items.summary: Docker's Docker Hub usage documentation sets out included usage and limits for each user type. A Hacker News submission reports that, from March 1, unauthenticated pulls will be limited to 10 per hour per IP address.

items.title: Discover the IndieWeb, one blog post at a time

items.title: Start a computer club in the place that you live (2023)
items.title_zh: 在你居住的地方发起一个计算机俱乐部（2023）
items.summary: A guide makes the case for starting a local computer club where people work on computers together, with an emphasis on programming and DIY shared computing infrastructure as well as art, music and open data science.

items.title: In memoriam
items.title_zh: 纪念：因《在线安全法》而关闭或屏蔽英国用户的服务

items.title: Why are QR Codes with capital letters smaller than QR codes with lower case?
items.title_zh: 为什么大写字母的二维码比小写字母的二维码更小？
items.summary: The post compares two QR codes that point to the same URL, one uppercase and one lowercase, and notes that the uppercase version holds fewer bits of data and is visibly smaller.

items.title: Debugging an Undebuggable App

items.summary: The post examines an app that carries a surprising number of anti-debugging protections and explains how to bypass them.

items.summary: Suckless.org hosts dwm, dmenu and other software projects focused on simplicity, clarity and frugality, and invites readers to learn about its philosophy and join its mailing list.

items.title: ConFit v2: Improving Resume-Job Matching using Hypothetical Resume Embedding and Runner-Up Hard-Negative Mining
items.title_zh: ConFit v2：用假设简历嵌入与次优硬负样本挖掘改进简历-职位匹配
items.summary: ConFit v2 addresses sparse interaction labels in resume-job matching by augmenting job data with hypothetical reference resumes generated by a large language model and mining hard negatives from unlabeled resume-job pairs, reporting average absolute gains of 13.8% in recall and 17.5% in nDCG over ConFit and prior methods.

items.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Graders
items.title_zh: 语言模型是少样本评分者
items.summary: The paper presents an LLM-based automatic short-answer grading pipeline that outperforms custom-built models, finding that GPT-4o offers the best accuracy-cost balance while o1-preview is less practical for classrooms due to higher error variance.

items.title: Guardians of the Agentic System: Preventing Many Shots Jailbreak with Agentic System
items.title_zh: 智能体系统的守护者：用智能体系统防范多轮越狱
items.summary: The paper proposes an evaluation and defense framework for LLM-based multi-agent systems, using a Reverse Turing Test and multi-agent simulations to detect rogue agents and deceptive alignment, tested with Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3.3-70B and DeepSeek R1; it reports 94% detection accuracy for Gemini 1.5 Pro but finds that longer attacks raise success rates.

items.title: Alignment and Adversarial Robustness: Are More Human-Like Models More Secure?
items.title_zh: 对齐与对抗鲁棒性：越像人类的模型越安全吗？
items.summary: Evaluating 114 models across 105 benchmarks and measuring robustness with AutoAttack, the authors find only a weak overall correlation between representational alignment and adversarial robustness, though specific alignment benchmarks, especially those measuring selectivity toward texture or shape, are strong predictors.

items.title: Secure and Efficient Watermarking for Latent Diffusion Models in Model Distribution Scenarios
items.title_zh: 面向模型分发场景的潜在扩散模型安全高效水印
items.summary: The paper proposes a watermarking scheme for latent diffusion models in distribution scenarios, decoupling watermark injection from a security mechanism to prevent leakage and escape while improving robustness against attacks.

items.title: Optimizing Singular Spectrum for Large Language Model Compression
items.title_zh: 面向大语言模型压缩的奇异谱优化
items.summary: SoCo is an SVD-based LLM compression framework that learns to rescale decomposed components with a learnable diagonal matrix instead of treating singular values as fixed importance scores. A three-stage training process progressively refines these scores, and experiments report gains over state-of-the-art compression methods.

items.title: Audio Visual Segmentation Through Text Embeddings
items.title_zh: 通过文本嵌入实现音视频分割
items.summary: The paper proposes AV2T-SAM, a framework that bridges audio features with the text embedding space of a text-prompted Segment Anything Model, leveraging text-image pretraining to improve audio-visual alignment; it reports better results on AVSBench and releases code.

items.title: Towards Optimal Adversarial Robust Reinforcement Learning with Infinity Measurement Error
items.title_zh: 面向无穷测度误差的最优对抗鲁棒强化学习
items.summary: The paper introduces the Intrinsic State-adversarial Markov Decision Process and proves that a deterministic stationary optimal robust policy exists within it, then proposes the CAR-RL framework to optimize infinity-measurement-error surrogates for value- and policy-based deep RL algorithms.

items.title: Geometry-Aware Diffusion Models for Multiview Scene Inpainting
items.title_zh: 面向多视角场景修复的几何感知扩散模型
items.summary: The paper introduces a geometry-aware conditional generative model for multi-view 3D scene inpainting that fuses cross-view information in a learned space, avoiding radiance fields and supporting few-view inpainting with state-of-the-art results.

items.title: Wrong Answers Can Also Be Useful: PlausibleQA -- A Large-Scale QA Dataset with Answer Plausibility Scores
items.title_zh: 错误答案也有用：PlausibleQA——带答案合理性评分的大规模问答数据集
items.summary: The authors release PlausibleQA, a dataset of 10,000 questions and 100,000 candidate answers annotated with plausibility scores and justifications, plus 900,000 pairwise comparison justifications, and show it is useful for multiple-choice QA and QA robustness assessment.
